column1: # Controls and classes the committed lane evidence shows kayfabe serving with NV_OK. Wherever the pre-I7 gate
# admitted one of these at a tag, the generated gate must admit it there too
# (crates/kf-rm/tests/ingress_parity.rs). Source: every 'control 0x... result 0x00000000' line and every
# successful alloc (hClass=... status=0x00000000, or a kayfabe-side 'alloc cls=... st=0x0') under traces/;
# the committed traces hold only part of the lanes' logs (traces/EVIDENCE_ARCHIVE.md), so this is a lower bound.
# Plus the controls kayfabe's code asks the gate about by constant (kf-rm chanlink / display / rmrpc policy).
#   0x20808159 answered by kf_rm::inittables before the gate (GSS-legacy, no ogkm tag exports it); evidence is a pre-v3 nvkvm log
#   0x20808162 answered by kf_rm::inittables before the gate (GSS-legacy, no ogkm tag exports it); evidence is a pre-v3 nvkvm log
#   0x20810108 refused in v3 already (traces/v3_windows/discovery_20261004/linux_baseline: fn76/0x20810108=0x56); the 0x0 hit is a Windows host-side signal file
#   0x0000cb33 NV_CONFIDENTIAL_COMPUTE: status 0 only in pre-v3 guest_boots logs; in v3 it has no alloc shape (refused after the gate either way)
